cases.prompt: It is the start of the quarter. Can you check whether the context behind our OD skills is still current and write up what needs attention?
cases.expected_output: Runs the freshness script read-only with skills, registry and bundle paths. Reads the bundle, skills, cross and registry tables. Drafts a hygiene report with an owner and action per finding. Edits no date and marks nothing verified.

cases.prompt: I made a small test folder with three knowledge notes, one of which has a valid-until in the past (fictional). Run the freshness check on that folder only and tell me what comes out.
cases.expected_output: Runs the script with only the bundle flag and the date override for a repeatable result. Reports the one expired file as EXPIRED and the others as fine. Names the OD lead as owner of the action. Does not edit the file.

cases.prompt: Run the staleness check but the knowledge folder path I gave you is probably wrong.
cases.expected_output: Notes the script exits with code 2 and a message naming the bad flag. Asks for the correct path instead of reporting from a partial run. Does not guess a path.

cases.prompt: What does the abbreviation CSP mean in our department?
cases.expected_output: Recognises this as a vocabulary question for the shared context skill, not a freshness check. Does not run the script.

should_trigger: Which of our skills still rely on an expired source?
A valid-until date is coming up next month, what depends on that file?
Is the decision table we quote still true or has it gone stale?
Draft this quarter's hygiene report for the skill registry.
should_not_trigger: Who is allowed to approve the new connection?
Update the sources_read date on the skill so it looks current.
Run the monthly risk reading against the register.
What is the difference between tracked and proven savings?
